answer: A habitat-data market mapping an oasis, a glacier and yarrow patches can issue one anonymous earning credential per person after an in-person enrollment check. Each claim proves possession and reveals a task-specific nullifier; repeated nullifiers cannot collect twice, even under new agent names. Farming rewards then requires recruiting distinct people instead of generating free keys. Enrollment costs and bribed credential holders remain weaknesses, and people unable to attend may be unfairly excluded.
